references.text: The prophet Isaiah describes the suffering and sacrifice of the one who was to come as a parallel to Jesus' call to carry his cross.
David speaks of seeking God and setting aside his life, which resembles Jesus' call to self-denial.
Jesus repeats the message about carrying his cross and following him, emphasizing the importance of this teaching.
Luke gives a parallel account to Mark, where Jesus urges self-denial and taking up one's cross.
Jesus speaks of hating one's life in this world to keep it for eternal life, which resonates with the message of self-denial in Mark.
